requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/uniq.js` and your own tests in `tests/uniq.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `uniq(array)` returning the distinct values keeping first occurrences in order. Uses SameValueZero (so NaN is deduplicated). Does not mutate the input.
